specialDefinition: Any character that is not a letter, a number, a combining mark or whitespace (symbols, punctuation and emojis count; a space does not).

message.es: Usa al menos 8 caracteres con mayúscula, minúscula, número y un carácter especial (hasta 72 bytes UTF-8); evita contraseñas comunes.
message.en: Use at least 8 characters with an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter, a number and a special character (up to 72 UTF-8 bytes); avoid common passwords.
